notes:
Summary: NimbusCue is an omnichannel CCaaS provider. Primary interest = real-time agent assist (streaming candidate suggestions, short-form templated replies, in-chat tool-calls to update ticket fields).

Key requirements: streaming first-suggestion <200ms for inline agent UI; sustained throughput for 400 concurrent active agents with spikes to 2,500 during promos; deterministic tail latency (p95 <350ms). Must support function/tool calling to Zendesk and internal ticketing with idempotency and audit trails.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration for agents, encryption at rest with BYOK/KMS, audit logs for every model call, configurable retention policies and partial EU data residency (EU customer traffic must stay in EU).

Quality guardrails: explicit hallucination mitigation (automated citation to KB articles), blacklist/allowlist for agent-facing suggestions, human-in-the-loop fallback on low-confidence answers, per-route safety policies. They emphasized: "We will not ship suggestions that contradict our KB — must be conservative."

POC goals: demonstrate streaming suggestion latency at scale; validate tool-calling reliability under spikes; show summarization accuracy vs. existing heuristic summarizer (target ROUGE-like improvement + reduce average wrap-up time by 35%).

Commercial: leaning enterprise; procurement expects Dedicated pricing and a 12–24 month commit to get the SLAs they need. Legal flagged data residency language; security wants KMS key lifecycle details.

Other notes: engineering wants quantization/optimized kernels guidance for on-prem appliance. CS wants playbook for fallbacks (route to simpler model when latency >SLO).
